description: This PHP source file defines the 'ViewListView' class which extends 'SugarView' and handles rendering and managing the list view interface within the SuiteCRM ModuleBuilder module. It includes methods for constructing the view, generating AJAX navigation crumbs, Smarty template assignments, and configuration of UI buttons.

classes.name: ViewListView
classes.description: Handles rendering the list view in the SuiteCRM ModuleBuilder, including preparing view templates, navigation crumbs, buttons, and contextual data for the list view interface.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Provides modules title parameters for display, including module name and title based on the current module context.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes ViewListView object with request parameters such as module, layout, subpanel info, and package origin.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: Placeholder method overriding parent to prevent bean loading for non-existent modules.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the list view either as a preview or as part of an AJAX response, fetching the appropriate Smarty template.

methods.name: constructAjax
methods.description: Builds AJAX crumbs and navigation for different contexts (ModuleBuilder or Studio), including handling subpanel and package navigation.

methods.name: constructSmarty
methods.description: Prepares Smarty template engine with view data, including fields, buttons, labels, help texts, and contextual module information.

methods.name: _constructTitle
methods.description: Generates the dynamic title for the list view based on module and subpanel context.

methods.name: _buildImageButtons
methods.description: Creates HTML for action buttons with images and scripts, arranged either horizontally or vertically.
